  ri = [1] * n

    q = p + md[p] - 1

def permute(n: int, k: int) -> [int]
  fact = [1] * (n + 1)
  for i in 1..n
    fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i
  odds, evens = (n + 1) // 2, n // 2
  used, res, r_odds, r_evens = [false] * (n + 1), [], odds, evens
  def cnt_choice(ro, re, L, npo)
    req = (L + npo) // 2
    if ro != req or re != L - req
      return 0
    fact[ro] * fact[re]
  for pos in 0..<n
    old_len = len(res)
    for x in 1..n
      if used[x] or (pos > 0 and res[-1] % 2 == x % 2)
        continue
      ro, re = r_odds - (x % 2), r_evens - (1 - x % 2)
      L = n - pos - 1
      cnt = cnt_choice(ro, re, L, x % 2 == 0)
      if cnt >= k
        res <- x
        used[x] = true
        r_odds, r_evens = ro, re
        break
      k -= cnt
    if len(res) == old_len
      return []
  res

def getMinSwaps(num: str, k: int) -> int
  def np(a)
    i = len(a) - 2
    while i >= 0 and a[i] >= a[i + 1]
      i -= 1
    if i >= 0
      j = len(a) - 1
      while a[j] <= a[i]
        j -= 1
      a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
    a[i + 1:] = reversed(a[i + 1:])
  t, a, s = list(num), list(num), 0
  for _ in 0..<k
    np(t)
  for i in 0..<len(a)
    if a[i] != t[i]
      j = i + 1
      while a[j] != t[i]
        j += 1
      while j > i
        a[j], a[j - 1] = a[j - 1], a[j]
        s, j = s + 1, j - 1
  s
